## Problem and change

Describe the trigger/problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue if applicable.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. State any checks not run and why.

- [ ] Typecheck, lint, unit tests, build and guardrails pass.
- [ ] Browser tests pass when relevant; UI changes include screenshots.
- [ ] A bug fix has a meaningful regression check.
- [ ] No credentials, local databases or unconsented recordings are included.
- [ ] Replay/simulated evidence is labeled; no live acceptance is inferred from mocks.
- [ ] Changed API calls cite official documentation; relevant docs are current.

## Limits

Describe remaining risks or acceptance work, including any live Twitch/provider behavior not tested.
